description.en: Brittle fracture avoidance per EN 1993-1-10 2.1 and Table 2.1: the check en1993.1-10.t.<member> compares the larger flange or web thickness with t_max by grade and sub-grade at T_Ed = T_md + dT_r + dT_sigma + dT_R + dT_eps,dot + dT_eps,cf (members carry T_md, the shifts and the cold forming radius); Table 2.1 is registered cell by cell for S235 to S460 and their sub-grades (JR/J0/J2/K2, N/NL, M/ML, Q/QL/QL1), the three stress levels 0.75/0.50/0.25 f_y(t) and T_Ed +10 to -50 C as unverified registry rows ndp.en1993.1-10.t21.<grade>-<sub-grade>.r<level>.t<T>: only the 49 cells of the 0.75 column of S235 JR/J0/J2 and S355 JR/J0/J2/K2 carry a number (from memory), every other cell is Unset and needs the printed table; t_max is interpolated linearly in T_Ed and between the stress columns bracketing sigma_Ed/f_y(t), a missing lower column or a ratio below 0.25 falls back on the next-higher-stress column (conservative, stated in the explanation), a ratio above 0.75, T_Ed below -50 C or no transcribed column is not applicable; the member diagram toughness:<member> plots t_max over T_Ed with the design point (T_Ed, t); a failing member carries a 3D failure glyph and label, plated panels carry no grade and are not checked
